mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.sports_meeting_id, p.user_id, p.team_id, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.user_code, u.name, u.gender, u.phone, u.college, u.major, t.name AS team_name FROM participant p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN team t ON p.team_id = t.id WHERE p.sports_meeting_id = #{sportsMeetingId} ORDER BY u.user_code ASC

SELECT p.id, p.sports_meeting_id, p.user_id, p.team_id, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.user_code, u.name, u.gender, u.phone, u.college, u.major FROM participant p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY u.user_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO participant (sports_meeting_id, user_id, team_id) VALUES (#{sportsMeetingId}, #{userId}, #{teamId})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.sports_meeting_id, p.user_id, p.team_id, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.user_code, u.name, u.gender, u.phone, u.college, u.major FROM participant p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE participant SET team_id = #{teamId} WHERE id = #{id}
